cbv7:0.1: The Discourse on the Great Blessings
cbv7:2.1: What a blessing is was thought about by gods and men for twelve (years),
cbv7:3.1: but they did not attain (true) safety; the thirty-eight blessings
cbv7:4.1: which were preached by the god of gods make all that is bad perish.
cbv7:5.1: For the whole world’s benefit and welfare we will recite that safeguard.
